# CeremonyVerse

> CeremonyVerse is a US-based service with two distinct offers: Indian wedding shopping for US families and Mexico destination-wedding planning and concierge support. Mexico services use private CeremonyVerse proposals and qualified local planning professionals for the assigned on-site work.

## About

CeremonyVerse organizes remote India shopping and Mexico destination-wedding planning. India-shopping differentiators include eligible live video review, documented approvals, measurement coordination, pre-shipping review, and US delivery support. Mexico services include full planning, partial planning, day-of coordination, family concierge, guest information, arrival, welcome-item, and India-sourcing help.

- [About CeremonyVerse](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/about/): Founder story, mission, and how the concierge model works
- [How It Works](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/how-it-works/): Step-by-step process from consultation to delivery
- [Services Overview](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/services/): India shopping and Mexico wedding planning and concierge
- [Pricing](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/pricing/): India tiers ($249, $799, $2,499) and private-proposal Mexico planning packages
- [FAQ](https://www.ceremonyverse.com/faq/): 15+ questions on trust, sizing, pricing, shipping, and cultural traditions

## Founder Experience & Service Boundaries

- CeremonyVerse was shaped by Bhamini's two multi-day family weddings: an interfaith wedding that moved to New Jersey and an Indian destination wedding in Mexico.
- India-shopping fees are flat by tier; product, shipping, customs, and local alteration costs are separate.
- Mexico planning and concierge prices are shared only through a private CeremonyVerse proposal.
- The proposal identifies the bundled CeremonyVerse service, outside costs, payment milestones, and responsibility for each decision.
- Timing, fit, color, customs clearance, and duty amounts are not universally guaranteed.
- Fit Assurance applies only to eligible made-to-measure garments when included in signed service terms.
- Strongest stated India sourcing relationships are in Surat and Delhi; other locations depend on responsible vendor verification.

## Trust & Verification

- Vetted artisan partners with personal relationships (not random Instagram sellers)
- Live video shopping sessions with HD verification of fabrics, embroidery, and color
- Payment milestones are defined in each signed proposal or service agreement
- Pre-shipping inspection and quality verification
- Shipping and available insurance are itemized for the approved shipment
- Fit Assurance on eligible made-to-measure garments
- Clear written proposals with the client price and applicable outside costs identified before approval
